reason: I already have a drawer full of half-used supplement bottles, so I'm not adding another one on impulse. $24.99 is fine, but I'd wait for a bigger coupon or a flash sale and compare the per-day cost first.
objection: Sachets feel like more packaging waste, and I have a drawer of half-used bottles already. I don't need another supplement I'll quit after a week.
would_change_my_mind: A deeper flash-sale price, around $19.99 for the first box, or a small trial pack so I can try it before committing to 30 days.
